summary: The root هجع (hjE) refers to the setting of a star or a light sleep in the early part of the night. It implies a brief, initial period of rest or decline.
lane: هَجْعَةٌ ذ (assumed tropical:) The setting of a star. (Sgh in TA, art. شرط .) See شَرَطٌ . -b2- A light sleep in the first part of the night. (S.)
